title: DoggyPlus
description: A fun wolf mod, where you get special powers based on where your wolf is!
body:
🐾 DoggyPlus – Supercharge Your Best Friend! 🐾
Give your wolf the ultimate upgrade! DoggyPlus turns your tamed wolves into powerful adventure companions that boost your abilities and fight by your side.

When your wolf is nearby, you’ll gain:

⚡ Speed Boost (configurable)

❤️ Regeneration (configurable)

💪 Strength (configurable)

🛡 Invulnerable Wolves for maximum survivability (configurable)

🐺 Wolves gain extra health and their own strength buff

All features are fully customizable through an easy-to-edit config.yml, so you can tweak distances, potion levels, speed boosts, and more to perfectly fit your server’s playstyle.

Benefits:
✅ Makes wolves actually useful in PvE and PvP
✅ Encourages player–pet bonding and unique strategies
✅ Lightweight, lag-free, and beginner-friendly
✅ Fully configurable — no code changes needed

Bring loyalty and power together — let your wolf be more than just a pet! 🐾
